xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2598: Issue view misreports an in-flight planning session: false "finished the plan", missing planning agent in tree, wrong phase banner

plan.title: Issue view misreports an in-flight planning session: false "finished the plan", missing planning agent in tree, wrong phase banner
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: A planning session that is alive but blocked on an operator question renders in the issue view as the exact inversion of the truth: the timeline says '<model> finished the plan' (gated on elapsed-time duration, not completion), the phase banner says 'The crew is writing code' (workRunning is derived from phase==='pending', which is what a planning-phase issue looks like), the AGENTS & STEPS tree omits the live planning agent (the session-trees pre-filter only recognizes work-agent dirs and the legacy .pan workspace dir, and the cockpit's non-null resource-allocated feature shadows the activity fallback), and the blocking question produces no AUQ modal or needs-you trip (commit 3d77214f55/PAN-2530 stripped the literal PAN-1520 marker from the deny hook's reason, so the JSONL detector classifies every hook-denied question as already answered). Root causes verified at file:line in the PRD (drafts/pan-2598.md on overdeck-state).
narratives.Proposal: Four surgical fix clusters, all additive: (1) session builders populate a real endedAt terminal signal and a planningComplete flag (from plan.status via findSpecByIssue + PLANNING_FINISHED_STATUSES) and HappenedFeed gates its done-lines on those instead of duration!==null; (2) the phase banner derives workRunning from actual live work sections; (3) the session-trees pre-filter learns planning agent dirs, the agent-<issue>-plan naming, the .overdeck workspace dirname, and live tmux, both builders enumerate agent-<issue>-plan, a tmux-alive planning session without state synthesizes a node, and the cockpit falls back to activity-derived sessions when session-trees yields none; (4) the AUQ deny hook re-emits the PAN-1520 marker, the detector additionally accepts the stable phrase 'surfaced to the operator', and a contract test executes the real hook so the hook<->detector contract can never silently break again.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No redesign of the cockpit layout or AgentsLane visual structure
- No change to the AUQ answer-delivery path (operator reply -> agent); detection/surfacing only
- No removal of the AUQ deny hook and no switch to native AUQ menus (separate design fork)
- No changes to src/lib/reconstruct/derive-phase.ts or the backend PipelinePhase read-model
- No change to the existing duration field semantics (additive endedAt/planningComplete only)
- No new polling loops or watchers; fixes ride existing queries/scans

autoDecisions.summary: Add endedAt/planningComplete as new fields instead of changing duration semantics
autoDecisions.rationale: Other consumers render duration as elapsed time; the no-loss rule forbids silently repurposing an existing field.

autoDecisions.summary: Detector robustness = restore PAN-1520 marker AND accept the stable phrase 'surfaced to the operator'; rejected 'any is_error tool_result counts as deny'
autoDecisions.rationale: A genuine AUQ tool error would otherwise be classified as a deny and wedge as forever-pending; two independent positive signals are safer than one negative heuristic.

autoDecisions.summary: Cover the agent-<issue>-plan spawnRun naming even though the incident planner used planning-<issue>
autoDecisions.rationale: The gap is verified real (spawn-prep.ts:621-625 vs the candidate sets), cheap to close in the same files, and would otherwise reproduce the same invisible-planner symptom for Cloister-spawned planning.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the banner in the frontend derivation it actually uses; leave derive-phase.ts alone
autoDecisions.rationale: The banner never consults the backend PipelinePhase read-model; rewiring it is a larger refactor with no bearing on the reported defect.

items.title: Session builders emit real endedAt and planningComplete instead of only elapsed duration

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
both route test files pass, including new cases for endedAt-only-on-end and planningComplete

narrative.Action: In the activity section builder (src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck.ts:335-359) and collectSessionTreeNodes (src/dashboard/server/routes/projects.ts:230-290): populate endedAt ONLY when the session has actually ended — rtState?.state === 'suspended', presence === 'ended', or state.stoppedAt is set while the tmux session is not alive — using state.stoppedAt (or lastActivity as fallback) as the timestamp; leave endedAt undefined for live sessions. Add planningComplete: boolean to planning-type sections, resolved once per request via findSpecByIssue + PLANNING_FINISHED_STATUSES (src/lib/vbrief/io.ts:353-379) — true only when a canonical spec exists with plan.status in the finished set. Do NOT change the existing duration computation (hazard H1). Extend the section/SessionNode type in packages/contracts/src/types.ts if the fields are missing there (endedAt already exists on SessionNode; planningComplete is new).

items.title: Given a planning agent whose tmux session is alive (presence active or idle), when GET /api/command-deck/activity/:issueId builds its section, then the section carries no endedAt and planningComplete is false while no finished spec exists
Given an agent state with stoppedAt set and no live tmux session, when either builder emits its section/node, then endedAt is populated with a valid ISO timestamp
Given a canonical spec for the issue with plan.status in PLANNING_FINISHED_STATUSES, when the planning section is built, then it emits planningComplete: true
Given live and ended sessions, when either builder emits its sections, then the duration field preserves its existing elapsed-seconds value (regression assertion in both route tests)
HappenedFeed renders done-lines only on real completion, and a waiting-on-you line for blocked sessions

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
new HappenedFeed.test.tsx passes: no done-line for a live idle planning section; done-line renders for an ended+planningComplete section

narrative.Action: In HappenedFeed.tsx (currently lines 62-76): replace the `section.duration !== null` gate with `section.endedAt` presence for ALL section types, computing endMs from endedAt instead of startMs+duration. For sections of type 'planning', additionally require `section.planningComplete === true` before rendering the '<who> finished the plan' line; an ended-but-not-complete planning section renders a neutral line ('<who> stopped planning' tone info). When a live section has awaitingInput === true, push a 'waiting on you to answer a question' line with tone 'bad' (attention) so a blocked planner is visible in the feed. Create HappenedFeed.test.tsx following the PlanCard.test.tsx pattern in the same directory.

items.title: Given a planning section with presence 'idle', no endedAt and status 'running', when the feed renders, then it produces no 'finished the plan' line
Given a planning section with endedAt set and planningComplete true, when the feed renders, then it produces the '<model> finished the plan' line with tone ok
Given a live section with awaitingInput true, when the feed renders, then it produces a 'waiting on you' line with attention tone
Given a work section with endedAt set and non-failed status, when the feed renders, then the 'finished writing the code' line still renders (no regression for genuinely ended work sessions)
Phase banner derives workRunning from live work sections, not phase === 'pending'

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
IssueMissionControl.test.tsx passes with new cases: planning-only issue renders the planning headline, not 'The crew is writing code'

narrative.Action: At IssueMissionControl.tsx:910, replace `workRunning={phase === 'pending'}` with a signal computed from the activity sections already fetched in that component: `sections.some(s => s.type === 'work' && s.status === 'running')` (the same shape NowPanel uses around line 727) — thread the sections (or a precomputed boolean) into the StatusNarrative call site. In StatusNarrative.tsx, no branch reordering is required once workRunning is truthful: with workRunning false, no beads, and hasPlan false, derivation falls through to the 'Planning what to build' branch (line 84). Add a defensive test that an issue with a live planning section, no work section, no plan and no review row renders 'Planning what to build' and never 'The crew is writing code'.

items.title: Given an issue with a live planning section only (no work section, no review-status row, hasPlan false), when the banner derives, then it renders the 'Planning what to build' headline
Given an issue with a live work section (type 'work', status 'running'), when the banner derives, then it renders 'The crew is writing code'

Given an issue with no live sections and unfinished beads (plan.done < plan.total), when the banner derives, then the existing in-progress branch still renders (no regression to the beads-driven path)
Session-trees feature pre-filter recognizes planning agents, .overdeck dirs, and live tmux

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
projects.test.ts passes with a new case: a feature qualifies when only planning-<issue> agent dir + workspace .overdeck exist

narrative.Action: In the feature-candidate filter at src/dashboard/server/routes/projects.ts:533-539, extend the qualifying conditions so a feature is collected when ANY of the following exists: ~/.overdeck/agents/agent-<issue>/ (current), ~/.overdeck/agents/planning-<issue>/, ~/.overdeck/agents/agent-<issue>-plan/, <workspace>/.pan/ (current), <workspace>/.overdeck/, or the shared tmux session-name context contains a session for the issue (planning-<issue>, agent-<issue>, agent-<issue>-plan, or strike-<issue>). Keep the checks as parallel pathExists probes like the existing two. This is the incident fix: during PAN-2597's planning window only planning-pan-2597/ and .overdeck/ existed, and the filter returned null for the feature.

items.title: Given only ~/.overdeck/agents/planning-<issue>/ exists (no work-agent dir, no .pan), when GET /api/session-trees runs, then the feature is included and its planning node is returned

Given neither agent dirs, runtime dirs, nor issue tmux sessions exist, when the pre-filter evaluates, then the feature is still excluded (no debris regression)
Both session builders enumerate agent-<issue>-plan and classify planning by role

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
both route tests pass with new agent-<issue>-plan fixtures classified as planning sections

narrative.Action: Add `agent-<issue>-plan` (the spawnRun(issueId,'plan') session name from src/lib/agents/spawn-prep.ts:621-625) to the candidate sets: candidateSessionIds in collectSessionTreeNodes (src/dashboard/server/routes/projects.ts:214) and the fixed candidate loop in the activity builder (src/dashboard/server/routes/command-deck.ts:277-283). Fix classification in both builders: a session is planning when its id starts with 'planning-' OR state.role === 'plan' (hazard H2: agent-<issue>-plan starts with 'agent-' and would otherwise classify as work). Sequenced after session-trees-prefilter-planning because both edit the same functions.

items.title: Given an agent dir agent-<issue>-plan with state role 'plan', when collectSessionTreeNodes runs, then it emits a node with type 'planning'

A tmux-alive planning session with no readable state still yields a planning node

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
projects.test.ts passes with a new case: tmux-only planning session synthesizes a live planning node

narrative.Action: In collectSessionTreeNodes (src/dashboard/server/routes/projects.ts), after the candidate loop: if context.tmuxSessionNames contains planning-<issue> (or agent-<issue>-plan) but no planning node was emitted (hasPlanningSection false because the agent dir or state was missing/invalid at projects.ts:230-234), synthesize a planning SessionNode: sessionId = the tmux name, type 'planning', model 'unknown', startedAt now-ISO fallback, status 'running', presence derived from deriveSessionPresence, tmuxSession set so the terminal is openable. This guarantees the issue's expected behavior: a planning agent appears in the tree whenever its tmux session is alive. Sequenced after plan-run-candidate-naming (same function).

Cockpit uses activity-derived sessions when session-trees yields none

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
IssueMissionControl.test.tsx passes: empty tree-sessions feature falls back to activity sessions

narrative.Action: In IssueTreeLane (src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Stage/cockpit/IssueMissionControl.tsx, around lines 462-463): when the resolved feature's sessions array is empty or absent while the activity-derived `sessions` memo (built at lines ~414-429) is non-empty, render the activity-derived sessions instead — e.g. `renderedSessions = feature.sessions?.length ? feature.sessions : sessions`. This closes the shadowing half of the incident: fetchCockpitProjectFeature returns a non-null resource-allocated feature with empty sessions, which currently suppresses the fallbackFeature whose activity sections DID contain the live planner. Preserve the deep-link path where the resource-allocated feature is null (hazard H5). Sequenced after phase-banner-work-signal (same file).

AUQ deny hook re-emits the PAN-1520 marker; detector also accepts the stable phrase

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors
existing pending-input tests pass
hook script parses (bash -n exits 0) and its REASON string contains (PAN-1520)

narrative.Action: 1) In sync-sources/hooks/ask-user-question-hook line 52, restore the marker inside the emitted reason: '...surfaced to the operator in the Overdeck dashboard (PAN-1520), where they answer it directly...' — string literal edit only; do not touch the script's control flow or its exit-0 error tolerance (hazard H6). 2) In src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts:253-270, extend isAskUserQuestionHookDenyToolResult to return true when the content includes EITHER the existing ASK_USER_QUESTION_HOOK_DENY_MARKER ('PAN-1520') OR a new secondary constant ASK_USER_QUESTION_HOOK_DENY_PHRASE = 'surfaced to the operator' (the hook's stable operative phrase), so a future copy-edit that drops one signal cannot silently flip denies to answered. Old transcripts with only 'PAN-1520' keep matching. Note in the PR: live sessions pick up the hook change only after pan sync re-provisions ~/.claude/settings.json hooks (hazard H3).
